scope: Current-source Kernel ARM64 image and network-disabled QEMU import smoke

build.command: docker buildx build --platform linux/arm64 --target kernel --build-arg KOKONUT_CLICKHOUSE=false --load --tag kokonut-kernel-current-arm64:local --file Dockerfile.kernel .

limitations: QEMU is code-only ARM64 evidence and does not establish compatibility or performance on physical Raspberry Pi hardware.
Power-loss, thermal, storage, network, 24-hour recovery, and the 4 GB memory profile remain open.
No database migration replay or live worker/provider operation was performed in this smoke.
